gitWorkbench.title: Source control
gitWorkbench.outgoingHint: These commits are on your current branch and have not reached its upstream.

Discard unstaged changes in these files? Staged changes stay; untracked files are deleted.
{paths}

gitWorkbench.undone: Commit undone; files and staged changes kept.
gitWorkbench.stashHint: Save unfinished work for later. Stashes belong to the repository.
gitWorkbench.noStashesHint: Save your work, switch tasks, then restore it here.
gitWorkbench.applyHint: Restore files and staged state; keep this stash.

gitWorkbench.popAsk: Restore this stash and remove it on success? The original stash stays if conflicts occur.
gitWorkbench.dropAsk: Delete stash “{message}”? Unrestored changes will no longer be available in the list.
gitWorkbench.stashDirty: Commit or stash current changes before restoring a stash.
gitWorkbench.stashConflictHint: The original stash is kept. Resolve and stage conflicts, then commit normally.
gitWorkbench.cherryAsk: Apply commit {sha} to the current branch and create a new commit?
gitWorkbench.revertAsk: Create a new commit reversing {sha}? Existing history is preserved.
gitWorkbench.revertMeta: Resolve conflicts to finish the reversing commit.
gitWorkbench.abortRevertAsk: Abort this revert and restore the previous state?
